instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot, low angle. In a grassy park near a large suspension bridge, a couple practices acro-yoga. The shirtless bearded man (R2) in black leggings lies on his back with his legs raised, supporting the woman with buzzed hair (R1) who arches over him in a backbend. The woman (R1) wears a white sports bra and gray shorts, balancing with her hands on the ground. In the far background, two tiny, indistinct figures walk. Natural daylight illuminates the scene with soft shadows and muted green tones.
elements: R2 lies on his back with legs raised to support R1
R1 is the lifted/acrobatic partner arching over R2 in a backbend
R1 balances with her hands on the ground while R2 supports her from below
R2 acts as the base underneath R1 rather than being carried by her
the acro-yoga scene takes place in a grassy park near a large suspension bridge
